title: Ashfall County
brief: Scavenge a flooded rural county, rescue stranded neighbors and hold an evacuation safehouse.

randomization.runtime: adapter-required; not established by authoring config

enemies.acceptance: Verify spawn rules, locomotion/navigation, combat, animation and rewards per stage.

chapters.title: The Last Pharmacy
chapters.story: Mara reaches a shuttered pharmacy with one promise: nobody leaves the county alone.

chapters.title: The Waterline
chapters.story: Ada hears families beyond the flooded road. Supplies must reach the refuge before dusk.

chapters.title: County Evacuation
chapters.story: Jonah can start the convoy if the safehouse holds long enough to gather every survivor.

requirements: Separate optional quest state from main story gates
Verify NPC giver, prerequisites, rewards, persistence and multiplayer authority where applicable

studioIntro.creator: ProgrammingSecurely
studioIntro.presentation: Game title and creator credits over the actual scene when available; no fabricated gameplay video.

systems.coreLoopSource: Scavenge a flooded rural county, rescue stranded neighbors and hold an evacuation safehouse.
systems.worldRules: Game-specific authored levels and optional seeded workshops; preserve runtime gameplay until an adapter is integrated.
systems.playerControls: Keyboard/mouse and controller navigation require native acceptance for this genre.
systems.npcRules: Verify cast presence, navigation, locomotion, interaction reach, dialogue and quest roles in native scenes.
systems.progression: Campaign gates, rewards, retries and save/reload must be tested per chapter.
systems.sideQuests: Optional quest chains must have explicit giver, prerequisites, state transitions, rewards and persistence.

playtime.freePlay: Define genre-appropriate replay or free-play progression; not yet accepted
playtime.acceptance: Measure normal play sessions; automated smoke duration and repeated captures do not establish playtime.

assets.policy: Use compatible owned art for characters, buildings, weapons, animations, audio and menu presentation. Keep gameplay logic, controls, hitboxes and progression owned by the game.
assets.provenance: Hash-pin selected original files, licence source and native references. Owned/downloaded/candidate is not proof of runtime integration.

requiredChecks: Every advertised story stage: start, objectives, victory/failure, retry, save/reload
Selected seed and alternate seeds: biome rules, sea exclusion, spawn clearance, routes and resource availability
Purchased characters/items: import, runtime reference, animation, collision and interaction
Menus: keyboard, mouse, physical controller, resolution and accessibility
Multiplayer if advertised: two machines on LAN, authority, disconnect/rejoin, persistence and progression
Measured playtime, performance, platform builds, distribution signing and Steam depot/release acceptance
acceptance.latestValidation: Docs/ValidationReports; distinguish current native evidence from historical reports
